title: Pokemon Stadium 2 Online 🤯
author: BourbonTree
selftext:
Hey what's up everyone! I created a browser based emulator for Pokemon Stadium 2. I have uploaded a video as a short demo so you guys can see it for yourselves. I'm also going to leave the link below so you guys can check it out for yourselves. Let me know what you think either here or in a DM 🙏🏽

The host of the game must have a copy of Pokemon Stadium 2 in order for it to work.

Now, you may be thinking, how is this different or better than using Parsec? The difference is you can play this on any device. In the demo, me as the second player, I'm using my phone. So it's basically cross play lol

Once you get to the website, you load up the game, then give your friend the code shown on the page.

There's a random team generator in case you want random teams.

Again, let me know what you think 🙏🏽 feedback and requests are welcomed

Don't load up the servers, now 😂🙏🏽

[Pokemon Stadium 2 Online](https://stadium-online.stadium-online.workers.dev/)
